newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies 12 issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies 12 issues for bond insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp said it has qualified for bond insurance the following 12 municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--San Diego Public Facilities, Calif., $67.6 million of revenue bonds, direct pruchase.
--Evansville Building Authority, Ind., $35 million excise and income tax bonds, direct purchase.
--Chatham, Mass., $6.9 million of General Obligation bonds.
--Noble County, Ind., Jail Building Corp $4.9 million of bonds, direct purchase.
--Kansas City. Mo., $28 million of water revenue bonds.
--Freehold, N.J., $5.9 million of school district bonds.
--Jefferson Township, N.J., $1.9 million of school bonds.
--Waldwick, N.J., $2.985 million and $420,000 of public improvement bonds.
--Riverhead, N.Y., $6.7 million and $1.7 million of public improvement bonds.
